test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A trader claims to sell rice at a profit of 25%, but also dishonestly uses a weight which is 15% less than what is mentioned on it. Find the total percentage of profit earned by the trader. (Round the answer to the nearest whole number.)
solution:
Given:

Profit% = 25%

Formula used:

Profit% = (Profit/Cost Price) × 100

Calculation:

Let the shopkeeper sells 1000 gm of rice at Rs. 1000.

S.P of wheat

⇒ 125% of C.P

⇒ 1000 × 125/100

⇒ 1250

Shopkeeper weight is 15% less

C.P of 850gm wheat

⇒ Rs. 850

Profit of shopkeeper

⇒ 1250 – 850

⇒ Rs. 400 

Profit%

⇒ (400/850) × 100

⇒ 47.05%

∴ The total proﬁt percentage is 47%.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
